about: Peggle nights is peggle's direct sequel: the same clear-the-orange-pegs core with a new roster of masters and dream-stage themes for each, keeping the bucket miracles and fever drama intact. It exists for the players who finished the first board set and wanted another fifty.
Popcap shipped it in october 2008 and it still lists on steam under the popcap label at a live price. Official route, standing beside the original rather than replacing it.
A 2008 casual 2d at the bottom of the requirements ladder; not-tested until a real run.
